Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Siya - 10 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Sonali - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Vinod - 45 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
5. Savitri - 63 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Aditya stands by the road. Sonali, Vinod and Savitri stand near him.]

Savitri: "Sonali, what's the plan today?"

[Aditya rides his bicycle down the road.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya gets into the car.]

Sonali: "Yes, all right."

[Aditya gets on the bus.]

Vinod: "Good job, Aditya!"

[Aditya gets off the school bus.]

Vinod (surprised): "What happened?"

[Aditya hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Aditya (gently): "That was fun!"

[Aditya pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya dances to the music.]

Aditya: "Show me too!"

[Aditya folds his hands and prays.]

Aditya: "That's great!"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Aditya: "And then?"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Vinod: "Careful!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Siya, Sonali and Savitri stand near him.]

Siya: "Let's begin."

[Aditya puts on his school uniform.]

Aditya: "And then?"

[Aditya combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Aditya (laughing): "Really?"

[Siya puts on red lipstick.]

Siya: "That's great!"

[Siya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Siya: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Night

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Aditya: "Okay, Mom."

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Sonali: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
